N O R T H S T A R   /   STRATEGY & OPERATIONS

FY 2026   •   STRATEGIC BRIEF   •   SEPTEMBER 2026

Good ideas.
Great outcomes.

A shared direction for our next chapter.

Every great year starts with a simple question: what matters most? For Northstar, the answer is clear. Build products people love, make every interaction count, and turn our momentum into lasting value.

Three priorities. One direction.

Our 2026 plan connects ambitious thinking with focused execution. We are investing in the work that brings us closer to our customers—and closer to the company we want to become.

01   Build with purpose	02   Grow together	03   Make it simpler
Deliver thoughtful products that solve meaningful problems.	Deepen relationships with customers, partners, and our team.	Remove friction. Create space for our best work.
Built for sustainable growth.

Our operating plan balances healthy growth with discipline. We will measure progress by the value we create—not only by the milestones we complete.

“Do fewer things, better. Make the important things matter.”
